title: Emerald Saver Account: Transferring funds to external banks
summary: Explains Emerald Saver Account external transfers: they typically complete in 2 business days after you initiate. If you need faster delivery, outgoing domestic wires are available for a $20 fee. Provides best practices to initiate early, verify recipient details, and use wires for time-sensitive payments.
faqs: How long do external transfers from my Emerald Saver Account take to complete?

What should I do before submitting a transfer to avoid delays beyond 2 business days?
